title: Amount of a Returned-Fee Courtesy Credit on the Crestline Credit Card
content:
Northgate's returned-payment courtesy schedule figures the courtesy credit on the most recent returned payment fee posted to a Crestline Credit Card account.

**Clause.** A returned-fee courtesy credit returns the returned payment fee in full: nothing is credited outright, the credit basis is the whole fee and the share applied to it is 1.0, so the credit equals the amount of the most recent returned payment fee on the account, rounded half up to the cent.

**Assembly.** The returned-fee courtesy credit is the part credited outright plus the share of the credit basis, the share never above 1.0 however much is added to it, rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure.

## How the fee is read

The latest returned payment fee entry on the account's card ledger, by posting date, at the amount it posted (a fee capped at the most recent statement's minimum is taken at the capped amount).

## Examples on hypothetical ledgers

| Latest returned payment fee entry | Outright | Basis | Share | Courtesy credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 26.00 USD | 0.00 | 26.00 | 1.0 | 26.00 USD |
| 19.75 USD | 0.00 | 19.75 | 1.0 | 19.75 USD |
